title: Do not use - return to a pharmacy for safe disposal
body: Expired medicine can be less effective or unsafe. Do not flush it down the toilet or pour it down the sink: the active compounds pass through water treatment and end up in waterways. Do not put loose tablets in household rubbish where children or animals can reach them.
steps: Keep the medicine in its original labelled packaging.
Take it to a pharmacy that accepts unused medicines for disposal - many hospital and community pharmacies do.
If no take-back point is reachable, ask a pharmacist how to dispose of it in your area.
Never flush medicine or pour it down the drain.
Scratch out personal details on the label before discarding the box.
